title: Mindset #6: let them fail small, safely
cta: Free Parent Script Cards · link in bio

copy.caption: Let them fail small, safely. A forgotten worksheet, a wrongly packed bag, or a guess that ran long are small, safe misses. Instead of rescuing, ask: “What would you do differently?” Small misses now build big skills later. Free Parent Script Cards: link in bio.
